reason: A vision utility for text-only DeepSeek Harness models that converts pasted or referenced images into descriptions through configurable VLM backends, with batch processing and web settings.

summaries.zh: 为文本模型提供图像理解能力，可处理粘贴、本地路径或网络地址中的图片，并通过可配置的视觉模型生成描述。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding for text-only models by processing pasted images, local paths, or URLs through a configurable vision model backend.

capabilities: Reads local image files and fetches images from HTTP(S) URLs
Stores pasted images in a temporary plugin-managed directory
Sends image bytes to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision model endpoint
Supports API key configuration and live settings updates
Processes batches of up to 10 images per request
